title: Physics-Transfer Learning: A Physics-Constrained Theory for Zero-Shot Generalization Along the Ladder of Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2610.22376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable out-of-distribution generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning, particularly when models are deployed in data-scarce high-fidelity domains. Existing approaches often rely on statistical distribution alignment, or invariance assumptions that can fail when domain shifts reflect changes in underlying mechanisms. Inspired by a longstanding paradigm in physics that understands complex systems by starting from tractable idealizations and progressively incorporating additional mechanisms and levels of fidelity, we propose physics-transfer (PT) learning, a physics-constrained learning theory for zero-shot generalization along a ladder of complexity. PT constructs chains of anchor domains (CADs) that connect low-cost source domains to complex targets and introduces computable feasibility and reliability indicators for assessing transfer before target-domain labels are observed. translated_abstract: 可靠的分布外泛化仍然是机器学习中的核心挑战，尤其是当模型被部署在数据稀缺的高保真领域时。现有方法通常依赖统计分布对齐或不变性假设，而当领域偏移反映了底层机制的变化时，这些方法往往会失效。受物理学中一个长期存在的范式启发——即从易于处理的理想化模型出发，逐步纳入更多机制和更高保真度层级来理解复杂系统——我们提出了物理迁移学习，这是一种用于沿复杂性阶梯进行零样本泛化的物理约束学习理论。PT构建了连接低成本源域与复杂目标域的锚定域链，并引入了可计算的可行性与可靠性指标，以便在观测到目标域标签之前评估迁移的可行性。在物理一致性和稳定性条件……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出物理迁移学习（PT）理论，通过构建连接低成本源域与复杂目标域的锚定域链，并引入可在观测目标域标签前评估迁移效果的可计算可行性与可靠性指标，实现沿复杂性阶梯的零样本泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes physics-transfer (PT) learning, a physics-constrained theory that constructs chains of anchor domains connecting low-cost source domains to complex targets, with computable feasibility and reliability indicators enabling zero-shot generalization along the ladder of complexity.
